name: Codex Desktop Model Selection for Agentic Workflows
summary: Configuring the Codex desktop application with a high-capability specialized model profile tailored for complex desktop tool execution and motion design generation.
steps: Open the Codex desktop application.
Access the model selection menu.
Select the targeted model profile ('GPT-6 Astra Extra High').
Verify that the model context is prepared for MCP tool attachments.
jarvis_use: Allows Jarvis to initialize specialized Codex model profiles optimized for complex multi-tool desktop automation.

name: Higgsfield After Effects MCP Plugin Integration
summary: Connecting the Higgsfield After Effects MCP server to Codex to enable programmatic AI control over Adobe After Effects compositions via dedicated tool calls.
steps: Navigate to the setup portal (higgsfield.ai/gpt-astra).
Download and activate the Higgsfield After Effects plugin and MCP bridge.
Verify tool binding registration (`higgsfield-use-after-effects` / `MCP ae_do`) within the Codex environment.
jarvis_use: Provides Jarvis with programmatic MCP tool access to drive motion graphics rendering inside Adobe After Effects.

name: Higgsfield Preset Category Template Selection
summary: Browsing and selecting pre-designed motion graphic category templates (SaaS, Localization, Presentation, Whiteboard) from a web portal to seed prompt generation.
steps: Access the Higgsfield web portal templates section.
Browse target categories (e.g., SaaS Animation, Localization Motion, Presentation Animation, Whiteboard Animation).
Copy pre-structured trigger prompts designed for specific animation genres.
Paste the selected prompt template into Codex.
jarvis_use: Allows Jarvis to select pre-validated prompt templates tailored to specific client video styles.

name: Structured Time-Anchored Motion Graphic Prompting
summary: Authoring multi-stage motion prompts with strict target canvas specifications (duration, resolution, fps), layer non-flattening requirements, and timestamped choreography breakdowns.
steps: Specify explicit canvas properties in prompt header: duration (15s), resolution (1080x1920), framerate (30fps).
Include mandatory delivery rule demanding native editable shape/text layers and .aep output rather than flat video.
Write timestamped choreography intervals (e.g., 0-3s entrance, 3-6s explosion/action, 6-10s resolution/tunnel).
Define material properties and physical asset descriptions (e.g., graphite panels, brushed metal, amber glow).
Instruct model to inspect available desktop tools prior to writing keyframe scripts.
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to write structured, constraint-driven prompts that force models to produce editable project files instead of flat video files.

name: Autonomous Multi-Tool Motion Pipeline Execution
summary: An agent pipeline that inspects local tools, invokes Blender for 3D model generation, and writes ExtendScript to program native After Effects keyframe compositions.
steps: Submit prompt to Codex desktop app.
Agent inspects environment tools via MCP server (`higgsfield-use-after-effects`).
Agent executes Blender headlessly to generate required 3D geometry assets.
Agent writes and executes ExtendScript files (`Choreography.js`) inside After Effects to build native timelines and apply keyframe timing.
jarvis_use: Allows Jarvis to execute multi-tool workflows combining 3D mesh creation with 2D/3D compositing programmatically.

name: In-App Agent Execution Video Verification
summary: Verifying generated motion design outputs directly within the Codex desktop embedded MP4 preview player before downloading source project files.
steps: Observe execution status logs ('Working for 32s', 'loaded tools', 'ran commands').
Render intermediate preview MP4 file directly inside Codex chat interface.
Play video within Codex preview player to check choreography and keyframe timing.
Click downloadable project asset links once verified.
jarvis_use: Provides Jarvis with an inline quality-assurance step to check rendered media prior to project packaging.

name: Automated MCP Tool Execution Failover and Retry Pattern
summary: Self-healing pipeline behavior where the agent catches script warnings during MCP tool calls and automatically retries with native After Effects clean-rig scripts without stopping.
steps: Agent triggers MCP tool call (`MCP ae_do on higgsfield-use-after-effects`).
Tool returns script warning or execution error during ExtendScript evaluation.
Agent automatically catches error log, re-evaluates local host software state.
Agent switches to a clean-rig native AE workflow fallback and re-issues execution automatically.
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to recover from script execution errors during desktop UI/API automation autonomously.

name: Native After Effects Folder Tree Clean-Rig Organization
summary: Structuring generated After Effects project files into organized folder trees (01-DELIVERY, 02-SCENE, 03-MODELS, 04-SD_DESIGN) with non-flattened layers and camera rigs.
steps: Open generated `.aep` file in Adobe After Effects.
Verify structured folder hierarchy in project panel (`01-DELIVERY`, `02-SCENE`, `03-MODELS`, `04-SD_DESIGN`).
Inspect individual keyframe tracks on separate text, shape, and transform layers.
Verify active 3D camera controls and light rigs within main composition (`ORDER_CHAOS - MASTER`).
jarvis_use: Ensures Jarvis generates clean, standardized After Effects project structures ready for human post-editing.
